payload.summary: SE-XENO G8 is an executable archived research package. Current local rerun passes 11 of 11 archived tests and an exhaustive four-candidate ADD4 equivalence check over 256 inputs. Reusable ideas include separating canonical state, reader projection, selective control and semantic program identity, plus stable external-state handles. The archive explicitly lacks live Claude-reader validation and independent-agent replication, so its synthetic results remain bounded evidence.
